title: Bicarbonate reclamation in the proximal tubule
compartment: Proximal tubule lumen, epithelial cell and peritubular interstitium

steps.enzyme: Carbonic anhydrase IV (CA4), GPI-anchored on the apical membrane
steps.note: H+ enters the lumen mainly via NHE3 (SLC9A3), 1:1 for Na+, and the V-ATPase

steps.enzyme: Non-enzymatic diffusion across the apical membrane
steps.note: Aquaporin 1 may conduct part of the CO2 (preliminary data)
The H+ formed is secreted into the lumen again
